The participants emphasized that salinity serves as a key indicator for water quality and various uses, and they believe that open ET provides a unified reporting platform that fosters trust and enhances the understanding of applied water versus pumped tail water, ultimately leading to a more sophisticated approach to managing water resources in the Delta.
